##  Introduction 
Internal Quality Assurance Cell, an internal quality assurance mechanism practiced in the University, is conceived as a mechanism to build and ensure a quality culture at the institutional level.  
  
Assam down town University has established its Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) in 2018, following the recommendations of UGC and NAAC. The primary objective of IQAC is to establish a system that promotes conscious, consistent, and catalytic improvement in the overall performance of the institution. The IQAC functions as a significant part of the Institution and strives to achieve the objective of enhancing quality and sustaining development.
##  Aims and Objectives 
  * To develop a system for conscious, consistent and catalytic action to improve the academic and administrative performance of the institution.
  * To promote measures for institutional functioning towards quality enhancement through internalization of quality culture and institutionalization of best practices.


##  Strategies 
  * Ensuring timely, efficient and progressive performance of academic, administrative and financial tasks.
  * The relevance and quality of academic and research programmes.
  * Equitable access to and affordability of academic programmes for various sections of society.
  * Optimization and integration of modern methods of teaching and learning.
  * The credibility of evaluation procedures.
  * Ensuring the adequacy, maintenance and functioning of the support structure and services.
  * Research sharing and networking with other institutions across the globe.


##  Functions 
  * Development and application of quality parameters for various academic and administrative activities of the institution.
  * Facilitating the creation of a learner-centric environment conducive to quality education and faculty maturation to acquire the skills required for participatory teaching and learning process.
  * Organize feedback sessions with students, parents and other stakeholders on quality-related institutional processes.
  * Promoting information on various quality parameters of higher education.
  * To ensure the credibility of evaluation procedures.
  * Organization of inter and intra institutional workshops, seminars on quality related themes and promotion of quality circles.
  * Documentation of various programmes and activities to enhance the overall quality of participation.
  * To act as a nodal agency of the Institution for coordinating quality-related activities, including adoption and dissemination of best practices.
  * Development and maintenance of the institutional database through MIS for the purpose of enriching the institutional quality.
  * Development of Quality Culture in the institution.
  * Preparation of Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR) as per the guidelines and parameters of NAAC. 


##  Benefits 
  * Ensure clarity and focus in institutional functioning towards quality enhancement.
  * Ensure internalization of the quality culture. 
  * Ensure enhancement and coordination amongst various activities of the institution and institutionalize all good practices.
  * Provide a sound basis for decision-making to improve institutional functioning.
  * The credibility of evaluation procedures.
  * Act as a dynamic system for quality changes in HEIs.
  * Build an organized methodology of documentation and internal communication.

| 23-07-2026  | Allocation and Utilization of Computer Laboratories for Academic Session 2026–27  |  (View Details)
##### Allocation and Utilization of Computer Laboratories for Academic Session 2026–27
* * *
Dear Sir/Madam This is to inform you that the computer laboratories have been allocated to the respective Faculties of Study for conducting regular practical classes during the Academic Session 2026–27. The laboratory allocation details are attached herewith for your reference.  [(Download Attachment) ](https://dtct-academic-geekworkx.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/ckeditor/2026/07/23/1795478789.pdf) **The following guidelines may kindly be noted:**
  1. The allocated laboratory will be given **first preference** for utilization by the respective Faculty of Study for conducting its scheduled practical classes.
  2. All computer laboratories are considered **University resources** and may be utilized by students and faculties of other Schools, subject to availability and with prior coordination, ensuring that the regular academic activities of the assigned Faculty are not affected.
  3. In case a computer laboratory is assigned to more than one Faculty of Study, the concerned Faculties are requested to **mutually coordinate and finalize the laboratory schedule prior to scheduling practical classes** to ensure the effective utilization of the laboratory and to avoid scheduling conflicts. 
  4. The **Common Computer Centre** shall remain open for use by all Faculties, staffs and students, subject to availability and the applicable usage schedule.
  5. The **IT Cell** may utilize any of the computer laboratories for conducting **Computer-Based Tests (CBTs)** or other University-approved external examinations whenever required. In such cases, the concerned Faculty/School will be informed well in advance to facilitate necessary academic adjustments.

Your cooperation in ensuring the optimal utilization and effective management of the University computer laboratories is highly appreciated. **For any queries or clarification regarding the laboratory allocation, kindly contact the IT Cell.** Thank you.  |

AdtU blue t-shirt, Solid black pant and Closed Black shoes for both boys and girls from **1st of September 2025.**  
  
**Old AdtU uniforms and white AdtU t-shirts have been discontinued and are no longer part of official AdtU dress code.**

For the National Academic Depository (NAD), students are informed to obtain the ABC ID (Academic Bank of Credit ID) and submit the ABC ID in the a-Connect App. To obtain the ABC ID the students need to visit [http://www.abc.gov.in](http://www.abc.gov.in/) and Register in the ABC Portal. After registration students will get the 12 digit ABC ID/APAAR ID. For reference students may follow the steps shown in the enclosed file. [Click here for the Steps](https://dtct-academic-geekworkx.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/ckeditor/2024/12/07/793930412.pdf) After getting the ABC/APAAR ID students need to visit a-Connect App and enter the 12 digit ABC ID available there and upload. Thank you, Prof. (Dr.) Joydeep Goswami Controller of Examinations

##### Creation of ABC ID
* * *
For the National Academic Depository (NAD), students are informed to obtain the ABC ID (Academic Bank of Credit ID) and submit the ABC ID in the a-Connect App. To obtain the ABC ID the students need to visit [http://www.abc.gov.in](http://www.abc.gov.in/) and Register in the ABC Portal. After registration students will get the 12 digit ABC ID/APAAR ID. For reference students may follow the steps shown in the enclosed file. [Click here for the Steps](https://dtct-academic-geekworkx.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/ckeditor/2024/12/07/793930412.pdf) After getting the ABC/APAAR ID students need to visit a-Connect App and enter the 12 digit ABC ID available there and upload. Kindly treat the matter as very urgent and kindly complete the process by December 12, 2024 (Thursday). All the PCs are requested to cooperate in getting the ABC ID. Thank you, Prof. (Dr.) Joydeep Goswami Controller of Examinations

##### Guidelines for Faculty Members: Updating Profile on AdtU Website via Academic Portal
* * *
This is to inform all the faculty members to upload their profile details in the ERP system at the earliest. This will ensure that the profiles are visible on the AdtU website. **Kindly upload the following information:** 1. Formal Photo with white-colored background (with the identity card and blazer)  
2. Qualification in tabular format(from HSSLC onwards)  
3. Research Interest  
4. Experience in tabular format (mentioning the place, position and time period)  
5. Research and Publications  
6. Personal Interests  
7. Other Achievements We are sharing a sample profile link for your reference: [Click here to view](https://adtu.in/teaching-faculties/TVRZNA==/hod-dean-ic-international-affairs.html) Thank you for your kind cooperation. **Note:** a. In the AdtU website the faculty member profile link is available under the Quick links in the footer section.  b. We also request all the faculty members to kindly check their profiles to ascertain that it conforms to the sample profile. **Please consider it urgent.** Regards  
Website Management Team  |

| 06-09-2024  | Application for Convocation  |  (View Details)
##### Application for Convocation
* * *
**The link to apply for the Convocation-2024 is available in A-Connect App and the last date of application would be September 15, 2024.**
## **Guidelines for uploading passport photo in the convocation application form:**
1) The photograph should be in colour and of the size of 2 inch x 2 inch (51mm x51  
mm). Maximum Size 100 KB  
2) The photograph must be in uniform and must not wear colored or dark glasses  
during the snap.  
3) The photo print should be clear and with continuous tone quality. Photograph should have:-
  * **frontal view of full face, eyes open.**
  * **present full head from top of hair to bottom of chin. The head should be in the centre of the frame.**
  * **have a background of plain white or off-white.**
  * **not have any distracting shadows on the face or on the background.**

  
4) Head should face the camera directly and should not tilt or turned. Photo must show both  
edges of the face clearly.  
5) The eyes must be clearly visible and must not be covered by hairs or eye glass frames.  
6) Head coverings are not permitted except for religious reasons, but the facial features from  
bottom of chin to top of forehead and both edges of the face must be clearly shown.  
7) The expression on the face should look natural. **Photograph not taken by the aforementioned instructions will not be considered and ADTU  
will not be responsible if certificates are not ready prior to convocation date due to this lapse on  
the part of the students.** **By Order** **Controller of Examinations**  |

## Regarding Payment Issues (if any) with Compartmental Form and Unable to download Compartmental Exam Admit Card, January 2024
Dear Students, This is to inform you all that if any students are having trouble with compartmental form payments such as the money has been deducted from your accounts but still, the payment status shows as "pending," or unable to make a payment due to any technical issues or unable to download the admit card, submit an application with payment proof to your respective mentors and request your mentor to submit your application to me (**Examination cell**) at the earliest. Thank You Examination Cell, AdtU  |

| 07-08-2023  | Guidelines for uploading passport photo in the convocation application form.  |  (View Details)
##### Guidelines for uploading passport photo in the convocation application form.
* * *
## **Guidelines for uploading passport photo in the convocation application form:**
1) The photograph should be in colour and of the size of 2 inch x 2 inch (51mm x51  
mm). Maximum Size 100 KB  
2) The photograph must be in uniform and must not wear colored or dark glasses  
during the snap.  
3) The photo print should be clear and with continuous tone quality. Photograph should have:-
  * **frontal view of full face, eyes open.** â€‹â€‹â€‹â€‹â€‹â€‹â€‹
  * **present full head from top of hair to bottom of chin. The head should be in the centre of the frame.**
  * **have a background of plain white or offâ€white.**
  * **not have any distracting shadows on the face or on the background.**

  
4) Head should face the camera directly and should not tilt or turned. Photo must show both  
edges of the face clearly.  
5) The eyes must be clearly visible and must not be covered by hairs or eye glass frames.  
6) Head coverings are not permitted except for religious reasons, but the facial features from  
bottom of chin to top of forehead and both edges of the face must be clearly shown.  
7) The expression on the face should look natural. **Photograph not taken by the following mentioned instructions will not be considered and ADTU  
will not be responsible if certificates are not ready prior to convocation date due to this lapse on  
the part of the students.** **By Order** **Controller of Examinations**  |

| 21-07-2023  | Student Mobility Program in Poland for the upcoming academic year of 2023-2024  |  (View Details)
##### Student Mobility Program in Poland for the upcoming academic year of 2023-2024
* * *
Dear Students, We are pleased to announce an exciting opportunity for Assam down town University students: a Student Mobility Program in Poland for the upcoming academic year of 2023/2024. We warmly welcome your interest in studying at PSW. For all relevant information regarding the exchange program at PSW, please visit the following link: (https://powislanska.edu.pl/umiedzynarodowienie/erasmus/student2/incoming-students/). This resource will provide you with comprehensive details about the program, including courses, accommodation, and student life at Powi?la?ski University, Poland. We encourage you to carefully consider this exciting opportunity and submit your name to be considered for the program at PSW. Interested students are requested to fill out the Google Form before 28th July 2023. Should you have any questions or require further information, please do not hesitate to contact us. We look forward to facilitating your Student Mobility experience at Powi?la?ski University, Poland. **For more information reach out to us at international.affairs@adtu.in +91 98643 60480.** ![](https://dtct-academic-geekworkx.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/ckeditor/2023/07/21/919159802.jpeg)  |

| 26-03-2023  | Important Security Notice - Do not share ERP (Academic and Examination) portal login details  |  (View Details)
##### Important Security Notice - Do not share ERP (Academic and Examination) portal login details
* * *
**Important Security Notice - Do not share ERP (Academic and Examination) portal login details** Dear all,  
I am writing to inform you all about a critical security issue that we have observed recently. We have received reports of individuals contacting employees via email or message, requesting their ERP portal login credentials.  
We want to remind you that it is essential that you do not share your login details with anyone, even if they claim to be from the IT cell or any other department. Please note that IT cell will never ask you to share your login credentials via email or message.  
If you receive any such requests for your login credentials, please change your password immediately and report it to the IT cell. We will investigate and take appropriate action to ensure the security of our systems.  
Thank you for your cooperation and for helping us keep our systems secure. Regards,  
IT Cell, ADTU  |

| 20-09-2022  | ISSN 2583-4657 for "Annals of Multidisciplinary Research, Innovation and Technology (Online)"  |  (View Details)
##### ISSN 2583-4657 for "Annals of Multidisciplinary Research, Innovation and Technology (Online)"
* * *
The "Annals of Multidisciplinary Research, Innovation and Technology (AMRIT)”, a research journal published by the Assam down town University online has received the ISSN (International Standard Serial Number) from the ISSN National Centre, India. The Journal ISSN is 2583-4657. The first issue of the journal (Volume 1 Issue 1, 2022) can be seen in the AdtU official website. This achievement of the university will go a long way in improving the standard and quality of the journal. The Editorial Board and the Publisher of the journal seek cooperation from all concerned for the upward growth of the journal and invite articles from the authors at any time for publication as per the guidelines of the journal.   
Prof. (Dr.) Dharmeswar Das  
Editor-in-Chief, Annals of Multidisciplinary Research, Innovation and Technology (AMRIT)  
Chairman, Research, Innovation and Technology, Assam down town University.  |

##### Important Announcement Related to Convocation 2022
* * *
**In continuation of the Convocation Notice, a few points were added for the students to apply for the convocation in 2022. The points are mentioned for your information and circulation.** 1. The students from the **batches ending 2020 and 2021** who graduated from the university in their respective graduating year and have not applied for convocation may now apply only through ERP. 2. The students from the **batches ending 2020 and 2021** who graduated after appearing in the compartmental examination must apply for convocation through the ERP portal. 3. The students from the **batches ending 2020 and 2021** who graduated from the university but never applied for convocation may apply for convocation through ERP. However, if these categories of students are not able to apply through ERP because their names were moved to Alumni List or for some other causes may report the same to their respective PC. The PCs may inform the CoE office and IT Office for Solution. 4. The students from the **batches ending** **before 2020** and not applied for Convocation or passed out recently may apply for convocation this time manually. These categories of students may apply through a form available with the Students' Help Desk on the ground floor of A Block attaching documents and a passport photograph. 5. The students of **MSc Nursing and BSc. Post Basic Nursing** may apply for Convocation manually by filling up the forms available with the Students' Help Desk on the ground floor of A Block attaching documents and a passport photograph. 6. All the students for the **ending batch of 2022** may apply for convocation only through the ERP portal.  |

![](https://dtct-academic-geekworkx.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/ckeditor/2022/02/25/1035890893.jpeg) Title: dtVL Ideation 2.0: Inviting Innovators and Startups to avail INTEREST FREE loan upto Rs. 2 lakhs down town Venture Labs calls for applications from Innovators, students, faculty members, Startups and aspiring entrepreneurs for availing soft loan upto Rs. 2 lakhs and incubation facility. The proposals should be submitted along with a presentation in pdf/ppt format in the link given below and should contain details about the idea or innovation, business model/revenue model, competitive advantage, traction (If any), Founders' details and most importantly a plan of action for next 12 months including financial projections.  Salient Features: a) The program is sector agnostic and hence no restriction in terms of sector or industry verticals. Anyone with any innovation or Startup idea can apply for this program. b) Winner/s will receive Interest Free loan upto Rs. 2 lakhs for a duration of 12 months from the date of disbursement.  The applicants shall have to undergo 2 rounds of evaluation. Those Startups/Individuals who qualify in the screening round will be called for pitch presentations online. Interested Individuals and Startups are requested to [Click here to apply](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfrMlA1L3Q354_9hdfVhCd6TmLHEXkjVbXECGcUZ1bXhV4MiA/viewform) Last date for idea submission is **12th March, 2022.**  |

##### TIDE 2.0: Inviting Application for Funding opportunities
* * *
![](https://dtct-academic-geekworkx.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/ckeditor/2022/02/25/867950723.jpeg) Event Name- TIDE 2.0: Inviting Application for Funding opportunities down town Venture Labs, AdtU; supported under Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs (TIDE 2.0) by MeitY, GoI calls for applications from aspiring Tech Innovators with disruptive innovations in healthcare, Education and other important areas for availing funding and incubation support under the following categories. 1) Entrepreneurship in Residence (EiR): **Rs. 4 lakhs for an innovator or Startup at 'Idea to Prototype stage'.** 2) Grant: Rs. 7 Lakhs for an innovator or Startup: **Rs. 7 Lakhs for an innovator or Startup at 'Proof of Concept(PoC) to MVP stage'** Applicants under both the categories must be working on innovative ideas or products leveraging IoT, AI-ML, Blockchain/Robotics etc. in the priority sectors such as Healthcare, Education, Agriculture, Financial inclusion including digital payments, Infrastructure and transportation, Environment and Clean tech, Clean energy solutions and other emerging areas.  Interested Innovators and Startups are requested to [Click here to apply](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfaPY3aa6TUkvhSMXLWcbUSFu6Lh_L1glibuwrk8h4r526kUw/viewform) . Last date for idea submission is **15th March, 2022.**  |

##### Guidelines for newly joined faculty members for updating their profile in ERP
* * *
Greetings of the day: This is to inform all the newly joined faculty members to upload the Profile details in the ERP including a formal profile photo. Kindly upload the following information: 1. Formal Photo with white-colored background (with the identity card)  
2. Qualification in tabular format(from HSSLC onwards)  
3. Research Interest  
4. Experience in tabular format (mentioning the place, position and time period)  
5. Research and Publications  
6. Personal Interests  
7. Other Achievements We are sharing a reference sample in the link: [Click here to view](https://adtu.in/teaching-faculties/TVRZNA==/hod-dean-ic-international-affairs.html) Thank you for your kind cooperation. Note: a. In the AdtU website the faculty member profile link is available under the important links in the footer section and also available under the faculty of study homepage (within the programme page the link for faculty of study home page is available). Please consider it urgent. b. We also request all the faculty members to kindly check their profiles to ascertain that it conforms to the sample profile. Regards  
Website Management Team  |

* * *
Dear All This is my gentle reminder and request to you all. Today is 09.11.2021, and the last date of depositing fee by the present odd semester student for their upcoming even semester is 15.11.21, still 70% concerned students has not cleared their dues, so I request you all kindly to discuss with the respective program coordinators and solve the matter by due date. Further to this presently our SBI Account is not active, so kindly ask the students through respective coordinators to pay through student portal / UCO Bank only. Lastly once again I request you all to follow up with the concerned persons accordingly. This is very important.  |

**Those who already applied in between 01/05/2021 to 07/05/2021 need not to apply again.**

Jaydeep Kakati  
FAO

##### CIRCULAR --- Celebration of INTERNATIONAL WOMENâ€™S DAY 2021(IWD)
* * *
This is for the general information that **INTERNATIONAL WOMEN’S DAY 2021 (IWD)** will be celebrated by Assam downtown University, Panikhaiti Guwahati in three phases i.e., on **4th, 5th and 8th of March 2021**. On 4th March 2021, Thursday Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences and Faculty of Nursing are organizing an awareness camp on **Adult Literacy and Menstrual Hygiene** with the women of Garo Basti. This will be followed by a General **Health Camp for Women and Children** which will be held on 5th March 2021, Friday. This is organised by various Faculty of Studies of Assam downtown University. The celebration of Women’s day will be concluded on 8th March 2021, Monday by AdtU Fraternity with a cultural Programme and felicitation of NCC & NSS coordinators. All the faculty members are cordially invited to attend the said programmes. Your presence is highly solicited. **(Ashim Barman),** **Additional Registrar (Administration),** **Assam downtown University** Issued with due approval from the competent authority. ##### Invitation- First lecture series to commemorate the death anniversary of Late Sahityaratna Harinarayan Dutta Baruah
* * *
Respected Sir/Ma’am,  
  
Greetings from HNDB Central Library, AdtU  
  
The Harinarayan Dutta Baruah Central Library, Assam down townUniversity is pleased to announce the**first lecture series to commemorate the death anniversary of Late Sahityaratna Harinarayan Dutta Baruah** which falls on the 22nd of February 2021, on the 18th of February 2021.  
  
In this regard Dr. Gobinda Prasad Sarma, Retired Professorand Head of the Department of English and former Dean, Faculty of Arts, Gauhati University will be delivering a talk tomorrow i.e. 18th February 2021 at 11 am in Auditorium 1, AdtU.**The respected Chairpersons, Deans, Associate Deans, HoDs and Programme Coordinators** of the respective Faculty of Studies are cordially invited to attend the function and join in the solemn remembrance of this great soul.   
  
With warm regards, Namrata Medhi  
Organizing Committee Member,  
HNDB Central Library  
Assam down town University  |

| 31-08-2020  | PARTING WORDS FROM THE HONORABLE VICE CHANCELLOR  |  (View Details)
##### PARTING WORDS FROM THE HONORABLE VICE CHANCELLOR
* * *
**To** **The University Fraternity.** **Dear all,** **As I lay down the Vice-Chancellorship of Assam down town University today, kindly allow me to share certain thoughts with you.** **We have all seen how the threat of corona-virus has forced us to take extraordinary measures across the nation. The uncomfortable quietness has indeed induced a thorough introspection in me too. Looking back, my years at AdtU had the elements of enormous challenges. But the cooperation of all turned it into a satisfying and enjoyable experience. In this connection, I must also make special mention of the esteemed trustees, the distinguished members of the Governing Body, Board of Management and Academic Council, all the teachers and employees of the University. From the strict adherence of academic calendar to the timely declaration of results, from successful ventures of NAAC accreditation to ISO certification, from implementation of digital classes to digital declaration of results, the journey was one of immense satisfaction.** **The credit for this must be accorded to the entire University fraternity. Please accept my heartfelt gratitude to all of you on this count.** **I am sure that our dear University will rise to new height with the synergy of your similar efforts.** **Thanking you,** **Prof. (Dr.) Amarjyoti Choudhury** **Vice Chancellor,** **Assam down town University.**  |

**_Memo No: AdtU/DoE/ 2020/026(A)_**_**Date: 16.05.2020**_
CIRCULAR
Submission of six monthly progress reports
This is for the information of all concerned that as per the Phd Regulations of AdtU, **a PhD research scholar has to submit a progress report (** Annexure XVII**) of****his/her PhD research work to the concerned FRC every six month, followed by a PPT presentation on the progress report before the concerned FRC for evaluation and further guidance.**
**All the PhD scholars are hereby requested to submit their six monthly progress report** as per the **schedule** given below:
1. Last date of **submission of progress report** to the **Member Secretary** (concerned FRC) is **7th August 2020.**
**2. PPT presentation** before the **concerned FRC** is **17th August 2020**.
**Note: -** Annexure XVII is **enclosed** herewith for the needful.
Thanks & Regards,  
Dr. Debojit Bhattacharya  
**Deputy Controller of Examination**  
Assam down town University

| 14-10-2019  | Invitation-Workshop on GAMESPEED AND RAMP TRAINING  |  (View Details)
##### Invitation-Workshop on GAMESPEED AND RAMP TRAINING
* * *
Respected Sir/Madam Warm greetings  I have the immense pleasure to inform you that, Assam down town University in collaboration with Transformers Academy of Fitness, Guwahati & Gayo Fitness Academy is conducting a two days hands on workshop on **GAMESPEED AND RAMP TRAINING** **Dates 15th and 16th October 2019** **The resource person for this course is** **IAN JEFFREY- Strength and Conditioning Expert**
  * **Senior Lecturer ,Faculty of Life Sciences and Education, University of South Wales, Pontypridd, Cardiff, Newport**

The RAMP warm-up was developed by Ian Jeffreys, it has proven to be the most effective warm-up for athletes and is used by many elite coaches around the world. The acronym ‘RAMP’ stands for **R** aise, **A** ctivate, **M** obilize, **P** otentiate. 
## The Science Behind The RAMP Warm-UP
While generally accepted as an integral part of every training session, the traditional processes of warming up have been the subject of surprisingly few quality research studies. Consequently, even when viewed solely as short term preparation, many generally accepted practices are based more on supposition than real evidence. This has led to increasing numbers of coaches to question traditional beliefs and investigate various methodologies that are able to optimise warm-up procedures.Today, warm-up procedures are evolving and new scientific research and practical evidence are being integrated into means and methods that have the capacity to significantly enhance the athlete’s warm-up. I am sure the students and the faculty members will get a enriching platform to share and learn from the expert In this regard I would like to invite you to the inauguration ceremony of the program to be held on Tuesday **15th of October** 2019 and will be very much glad if you can make your honorable presence and grace the occasion.  **Venue- Auditorium 1 above Jironee** **Time- 10:30am** Thanking you  --Dr. Abhijit Dutta (PT)Associate Dean Faculty of Paramedical Sciences Assam down town University Panikhaiti, Guwahati Assam mob-8638029986  |

| 31-07-2019  | Welcome to the new academic session 2019-20  |  (View Details)
##### Welcome to the new academic session 2019-20
* * *
**Dear Faculties,** As the summer comes to a close and we prepare together for the coming academic year, I wish to take this opportunity to welcome you all back to Assam down town University. The start of the new academic session is always a special time on our campus, with new students and faculties, new relationships and exciting conversations beginning a new after the summer months. We are fortunate to welcome the faculty members this academic year, whose diverse areas of expertise will build upon the remarkable dedication to excellence in teaching and research that characterizes our down town community. I very much look forward to the rich and rewarding semester ahead, create an environment for our students and faculties to pursue their passions and position our University for future success. Warm Regards, Dean of Studies, AdtU.  |

| 30-04-2019  | INVIGILATION GUIDELINES  |  (View Details)
##### INVIGILATION GUIDELINES
* * *
**Assam down town University** **Gandhinagar, Panikhaiti, Guwahati-26** (Permission Granted Via The ASSAM ACT. NO. VIII OF 2010, Gazette No. LGL9/2010/11**)**
* * *
**_INVIGILATION GUIDELINES_** 1.Invigilators need to be present in the Examination hall at least 15 minutes before the start of the exam. 2.Invigilators are to collect the answer scripts 10 minutes prior to the Start of the Examination. 3.Students are to be instructed by the invigilators not to keep any printed or written material with them and not to write anything on the question paper which leads to malpractice. The students must be asked to leave their belongings including mobile phones. 4.The answer scripts are to be distributed by the invigilators 10 minutes before the commencement of the Examination and ask the students to fill all the details in the answer scripts. 5.Invigilators are requested to maintain silence in the examination hall, so as to provide conducive environment for the smooth conduct of the Examination. 6.Invigilators are requested not to use mobile phones inside the Examination hall except any emergency cases. 7.Invigilators are to check whether the students have occupied their allotted seats as per the seating arrangements. 8.Invigilators are to verify the ID card/ Admit Card of the students in the Examination hall. 9.The invigilators are required to sign with date in the main answer scripts in the space provided. The number on the main answer book is to be mentioned in the candidatesâ€™ attendance sheet and the candidateâ€™s signature should be obtained in the attendance sheet. 10.Invigilators need to move around in the Examination hall to prevent indiscipline / any type of malpractice. 11.Invigilators are not to leave the Examination hall unless a reserve occupies his/her place as per the instructions of the officer-in-charge.  12.Swapping of Duties without the notice of the Examination Officer in Charge is not permitted. 13.Other faculty members except the invigilators are not allowed to enter into other Examination halls without the consent of the concerned Hall Invigilator. 14.Once the examination is completed, answer scripts are to be collected by the concerned Invigilator from the students and should be handed over to the Examination Officer in Charge. The invigilator will be held responsible for any loss of the answer scripts. Invigilators are requested to leave the examination hall after the examination only of answer scripts bundles when the packing are over. 15.In case of any discrepancies, the matter may be brought to the notice of Examination Officer in Charge. Dr. Mrinmoy Basak Officer In Charge Final Sem/ Year Examination, May-June, 2019  |

| 09-04-2019  | Application for Grand of Seed Money  |  (View Details)
##### Application for Grand of Seed Money
* * *
Respected All, Assam down town University has a provision to grant seed money as a start up for research projects to be undertaken by the faculty members to pursue research in various areas. The aim of the scheme is to strengthen the research activity especially among the young faculty members which will act as a catalyst for them to apply to the various funding agencies for major grants.  **Research proposals** are invited from the faculty members working at Assam down town University in the **format** provided. The faculty members are requested to submit research proposals for the seed money for research work in **hard copy as well assoft copy** to Mr. Debojit Bhattacharya, Deputy Administrative Officer, Assam down town University on **or before 30th April, 2019** (email : debojit@downtowngroup.in) and a copy to the Prof.H. K. Das, Pro Vice Chancellor and Chairperson, Internal Research Review Committee (IRRC) (email: hkdas1964@gmail.com).  The norms and guidelines of the schemes/ seed money for research works are given below to help the faculty in the preparation of proposals. 1.The project should be completed within a period of one year. 2.The proposal should clearly state the objectives; indicating the methodology, work plan, expected results, outcome of the project along with the budget estimate. The budget estimate should break down on half yearly basis. 3.The maximum grant available for the start up for research project is Rs. 40,000/- under the following heads. Ã˜Chemicals/ Consumable/Minor equipments and Contingency etc for the duration of the project. The budget estimate should provide the details under the heads such as consumables/ chemicals/ reagents and contingency etc. 4.All the purchase/ expenditure related to the mini project will be carried out by the Purchase/ Finance Section of the University subject to the approval of the Internal Review Research Committee. 5.Research proposal from young faculty members and in collaboration with other faculty members from within and other departments (intra and inter departmental) involving interdisciplinary research areas will be given preference. 6.Principal Investigators who have already been granted research grants are not eligible to apply. 7.The selection of the project will be based on peer review and presentation of short listed proposals before an expert committee. 8.On receipt of approval letter from the authority, the Principal Investigator is requested to implement the project and submit the acceptance letter to the authority. 9.The Principal Investigator should submit monthly progress report along with the statement of expenditure etc to the Internal Research Review Committee. 10.A bound copy of the final report of the work done with details to be submitted to the Research Cell of the University on completion of the project.    
**Format of the project proposal** **(Seed Money for Research work, Assam down town University** **Panikhaiti, Gauhati-Assam 781026)** (Project Proposal /Research Ideas (within 2500 words) **a**. Title of the Project proposal/Research Idea  **b**. Concept Note (in 400 words)  **c**. Feasibility of the idea  **d**. Biodata of the Investigators: 1. * * *
Memo No **_DCE /OL/007/2019_** Date: 12/01/2019 CIRCULAR This is for information of all concerned that the students who had appeared their Odd Semester Examination held in Nov-December, 2018 as Regular Candidates and are willing to go for rechecking of their Answer Scripts can pay their re-checking Fees Online in students ERP Module. Those who cannot pay the fees online due to certain problems are to pay the same at the University Cash Counter. * * *
# **Giving is the Greatest Act of Grace"**
This is to inform all the employees of the Down Town Group that, this winter the Department of Social Work is organising a "**Cloth Donation Drive** " which will benefit the people of Rajabari Village in Panikhaiti area, Guwahati. It is a kind request to you all to grab this opportunity to extend your happiness to the less fortunate, by donating unwanted woolen clothes (of all age groups), Blankets, Bed Sheets etc in good and usable condition. **Collection Point:** Collection Box will be available at all the Blocks of the University Campus and Down Town Hospital. **_Contact Details:_**  
**Purabi Deka: 8638721123**  |

##### NOTIFICATION- Completion of Registration Process for Existing Students (2nd sem onwards)
* * *
**Memo No: AdtU/DR-A/F-1/2018/030****Date: 03.10.2018** **_NOTIFICATION_** **_Completion of Registration Process for Existing Students (2 nd Sem onwards)_** This is for general information to all concerned that **all the students of AdtU (2 nd Semester onwards)** need to complete their **Course Registration Form in the ERP Module** in consultation with respective **Faculty Members** in order to complete their **Registration Process on or before** _**08 th of October, 2018**_ without fail or else their status will be moved to Dropout. Students are requested to contact their respective Programme Coordinators/Mentors, Faculty of Study wise to complete the formalities as per the given schedule:  
 |  **Date**  |  **Time**  |  **Faculty of Study**  |  **Venue**  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
|  05/10/2018  |  9.30AM onwards  |  Pharmaceutical Sciences  |  Respective Departments / As informed by HoDs  |  
|  05/10/2018  |  9.30AM onwards  |  Faculty of Sciences  |  Respective Departments / As informed by HoDs  |  
|  06/10/2018  |  9.30AM onwards  |  Faculty of Engg. & Technology  |  Respective Departments / As informed by HoDs  |  
|  06/10/2018  |  9.30AM onwards  |  Faculty of Paramedical Sciences  |  Respective Departments / As informed by HoDs  |  
|  08/10/2018  |  9.30AM onwards  |  Faculty of Nursing  |  Respective Departments / As informed by HoDs  |  
|  08/10/2018  |  9.30AM onwards  |  Faculty of Commerce, Management, Humanities & Social Sciences  |  Respective Departments / As informed by HoDs  |  
Deans/HoDs of respective Faculty of Studies/Departments are requested to monitor the Course Registration Process for successful completion of the same before the last date.
IT Officer/IT Team to provide necessary requirements and support to complete the Registration Process as per the given schedule. 
Not applicable for students who have already completed their **Course Registration Process in the ERP** module as **per previous** instruction dated **25 th July, 2018** to all Deans, Faculty of Studies concerned for necessary implementation. 
Issued with due approval. 
Deputy Registrar (Academic)
Assam Down Town University

##### NOTIFICATION- Seeking Information on Activities/Events/Research/Individual achievements/Nominations of Professional Bodies, etc related details year wise for University Annual Report Preparation for the year 2016-17 and 2017-18

| 23-07-2018  | Invitation to Join the Facebook live Session on 24th July at 12.15 PM: Atal New India Challenge (ANIC) for Innovators & Entrepreneurs to win grants of upto INR 1 Crore for the Innovation & Startup to happen  |  (View Details)
##### Invitation to Join the Facebook live Session on 24th July at 12.15 PM: Atal New India Challenge (ANIC) for Innovators & Entrepreneurs to win grants of upto INR 1 Crore for the Innovation & Startup to happen
* * *
(Copied and Pasted as received from AICTE) Dear All, It is to inform you all that, Atal New India Challenge (ANIC) of AIM-NITI Aayog is going to be announced on 24th July 2018. ANIC is aimed at supporting innovators creating products based on advanced technologies in areas of national importance and social relevance through a grant based mechanism. The Atal New India Challenge invites professors, student innovators, and startups to apply for grant of up-to INR 1 crore to make it happen, for mentoring, incubation etc.  The vision of ANIC is;
  * To help create products from existing technologies relevant for national and social causes. 
  * To help new deep-tech products find markets and early customers (commercialization) in the context of India.

The scope of the program extends to developing an institutional mechanism and structure to channel potential innovative ideas for products and technologies from Professors, Students, Startups, etc. on their own or along with R&D organizations, academic institutions and even individual innovators.  **A joint Facebook live session will be held at 12.15 PM to 12.45 PM, on 24th July 2018.** All students and faculties with innovative ideas are encouraged to join the FB live. Prof. Anil Sahasrabudhe, Chariman, AICTE and Mr. R Ramanan, Mission Director AIM-NITI Aayog will join as speakers for the session. ##### Certificate Course on Lead Auditor ISO 9001:2015 QMS
* * *
IRCA Accredited Training Course on Lead Auditor on ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (QMS) INTRODUCTION Assam Down Town University proposes to organise IRCA Accredited Lead Auditor Development Course on ISO 9001:2015. IRCA, a division of CQI is the leading professional body for management system. IRCA certified auditors are recognised and acceptable worldwide. The successful participants will gain the title of IRCA certified auditor which is highly valued by employer. OBJECTIVE The objective of this course is to provide students with the knowledge and skill required to perform first, second and third party audit of the QMS. BENEFITS OF PARTICIPATION ï‚· Capacity building for design, implement and sustain QMS in any organisation. ï‚· Develop the knowledge and skill required to conduct a full audit of an organisationâ€™s QMS. ï‚· Develop expertise with the latest development and contribute to continual improvement of service. ï‚· Gain confidence to effectively audit QMS system in accordance with internationally recognised best practices. ï‚· Enhance career prospect of successful participant DURATION The course would be of 5-day duration at a stretch with 40 (forty) hours mandate. There would be an examination on the 5th day of the training which would be based on understanding of last 4 Â½ days of study. VENUE ADTU Campus. COURSE FEE â‚¹ 25,000 (Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand only) per participants. SCHEDULED DATE The scheduled date will be informed on receipt of confirmation from participants along with course fee. The course fee may be sent by demand draft in favour of â€œAssam Down Town Universityâ€ payable at â€œGuwahatiâ€. REGISTRATION OF PARTICIPANTS Registration is limited to 15 number of participants. The training course would be conducted by SGS, which is the worldâ€™s leading certification body. They are recognised as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 95,000 employees, they operate a network of more than 2,400 offices and laboratories around the world. Interested participants may submit their name to the Dy. Registrar (Administration) latest by **25th July 2018**.  |

Since it began in 1972, global citizens have organized many thousands of events, from neighborhood clean-ups, to action against wildlife crime, to replanting forests. **â€œBeat Plastic Pollutionâ€,** the theme for World Environment 2018, urges governments, industry, communities, and individuals to come together and explore sustainable alternatives and urgently reduce the production and excessive use of single-use plastic polluting our oceans, damaging marine life and threatening human health. **Faculty of Nursing** , Assam down town University is going to organize **poster and painting competition** at the university premises at **Ground Floor, Block - A**. The competition will be open for all university students and will be based on the theme.  **_Agenda:_** **10:00 am** : Inauguration of World Environment Day by Honorable Vice Chancellor. **10:05am** :Honorable Vice Chancellor declares the forum open for various activities â€“ a)Poster and Painting Competition for Studentsâ€™ at Ground Floor, Block â€“ A. b)World Environment Day Rally. c)Plantation of sapling. **11:50 am** : Proceed to Auditorium â€“ I, Block - C. **12:00 pm to 12:10 pm** : Speech by Honorable Vice Chancellor on World Environment Day. **12:10 pm to 12:25 pm** : Special Talk with reference to World Environment Day by Dr. Atanu Bhattacharjee, Associate Professor, Faculty of Pharmaceutical Science. **12:25 pm** : Prize distribution of Poster and Painting Competition. **12:30 pm** : Vote of Thanks. **Mr. Ashim Barman** **Additional Registrar (Administration)**  |

| 25-11-2017  | seminar by faculty  |  (View Details)
##### seminar by faculty
* * *
**_Saturday Seminar_** **_Topic:_****_â€œBiology to Bioinformatics and the role of Mathematicsâ€_**  
 |  **_Name of the Speaker:_**  |  **_Dr. Rajeev Sarmah_** _Associate Professor,_ _Department of Biotechnology,_ _Assam down town University._  |  **_![](file:///C:/Users/ADMIN/AppData/Local/Temp/msohtmlclip1/01/clip_image002.jpg)_**  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
**_Date of Presentation_** : 25/11/2017
**__Summary:__**
_Biology was descriptive in nature which eventually became quantitative with the enhancement, development and integration of various subjects from material science. These integrations gave rise to various branches in biology such as biomathematics, biochemistry, biotechnology, biophysics etc. The integration of Information technology to biology gave rise to Bioinformatics. The speaker will speak on the development of bioinformatics with special emphasis on the application of mathematics/ statistics on biology which has changed the way we see life in earlier days. The presentation will also focus on the construction of a Block Substitution Matrix which is used for sequence alignment done for comparison of sequences for various purposes._

| 14-11-2017  | Invitation for an Awareness program on Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) conducted in Assam down town University  |  (View Details)
##### Invitation for an Awareness program on Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) conducted in Assam down town University
* * *
**Assam down town University** **Gandhinagar, Panikhaiti, Guwahati- 781026** **Invitation Letter** **Subject:** Invitation for an Awareness program on Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) conducted in Assam down town University Respected Sir/Madam, On behalf of Assam down town University, I am pleased to invite you to participate in a two-days awareness program on Intellectual Property Rights (IPR). The program will be held at Assam down town University on 17th & 18th November, 2017 from 9.30 AM to 4.30 PM. Intellectual Property (IP) is a Right which refers to an exclusive ownership on varieties of Intangible Assets such as designs, discoveries, inventions etc. recognized under the Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) law. Copyright, trademarks, patents etc are some most common types of IPR. This two days awareness program will have speech from the eminent experts in the field of IPR. Experts will also guide the participants to file patent applications for their innovation works. Location map of Assam down town University and Information Brochure are enclosed. [**(CLICK HERE)**](https://adtu.in/academic/files/userfiles/file/BrochureIPR.pdf) Regards Dr Abhinav Gupta, Convener, Awareness Program on IPR Assam down town University  |

**_Memo No: AdtU/Dy.R/2017/45_** _**Date: 07/09/2017**_
**_Circular_**
As per the direction of Competent Authority, I am advised to inform regarding the **revised Student Mentoring procedure** w.e.f 2017-18 session.
The new guidelines set will be as follows:
**_Class wise Guideline_ :**
  * There shall be **1(one) mentor for 1(one) Class** in an academic session.
  * The mentor shall create a Class related **WhatsApp group** with all the Students & Class Teacher**.** All info from **common Whatsapp group** should be forwarded to this sub group by the concerned mentor.
  * The Class teacher shall coordinate assignments, routines, etc via this **WhatsApp group.**
  * The mentor shall maintain records of all class students along with **their contact noâ€™s and parents/ guardianâ€™s contact noâ€™s**.
  * The mentor shall inform all the concerned parents that they are the class mentor for the academic session and in case of any problem they can be contacted.
  * In case of a studentâ€™s absence from class, the mentor shall contact the student.
  * The mentor shall conduct a **class meeting once a fortnight**. It may be done in the class itself.
  * The mentor shall maintain the **attendance status, fees status, registration status, admit card status** of all their students.
  * The mentor shall maintain a **log of all reports, incidents** , etc.
  * The mentor shall conduct **PTM (Parents Teacherâ€™s Meet)** once a semester.
  * Every semester a feedback will be taken from respective class by the HR Dept.


**_Common Guideline:_**
  * A **common Whatsapp group of all Class Mentors** with 1 member from Admission Cell & 1 member from Placement Cell shall be created by HR Officer.
  * This **common Whatsapp group** shall be moderated by HR Officer .There shall be only work related posts.


Thanks and Regards,
Deputy Registrar (Administration)

**Sub: IISF-2017 details for circulation among students and participation.** **Startup Contest 2017** All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) in collaboration with Vijnan Bharati (VIBHA) with support from many other lead government agencies involved in innovation and start up initiatives is organizing â€œNational Start-up Summit-2017â€ under the aegis of **India International Science Festival (IISF 2017,** [http://scienceindiafest.org/](http://scienceindiafest.org/) **).** This is a joint mega event of Ministry of Science and Technology and Ministry of Earth Sciences will be held during October 13th â€“ 16th 2017 at Chennai. **â€œStart-up Contest - 2017â€** is framed under the Start-up Summit 2017 to scout, award and support best start-ups happening in academic institutions across the country. Also aim to reward best academic institutions those are supporting Innovation and Start-up Ecosystem both in campus and regional level. Eventually, the shortlisted start-ups and institutions will get opportunity to attend and participate in **Start-up Summit 2017** which will be held during 14th - 15th October, 2017 at Chennai.  **For online submission and instruction, please visit registration portal** [**www.startup.aicte-india.org**](http://www.startup.aicte-india.org/).  **For detailed information on IISF-2017 events, check the following link** : _http://scienceindiafest.org/index.html_  |

##### Welcome to the new academic session 2017 – 18
* * *
**_Welcome to the new academic session 2017 – 18_** **Dear Faculties** As the summer comes to a close and we prepare together for the coming academic year, I wish to take this opportunity to welcome you all back to Assam down town University. The start of the year is always a special time on our campus, with new students and faculties, new relationships and exciting conversations beginning a new after the summer months. We are fortunate to welcome faculty members this academic year, whose diverse areas of expertise will build upon the remarkable dedication to excellence in teaching and research that characterizes our down town community. I very much look forward to the rich and rewarding semester ahead, create an environment for our students and faculty to pursue their passions and position our University for future success. We have been developing new ERP Module software for the University’s academic purposes, which includes students data, time table, lesson plan, students attendance, examination, internal communication including circulars, notices, information etc for a robust and up-to-date academic evaluation system. **Prof. Bandana Dutta** **Dean of Studies** **Assam down town University**  |
